name: Transfer Status Type 2 Code
definition: Specifies a type of transfer status or transfer event.

S019.name: Account Holding Information Request
S019.definition: Status report is sent in response to an account holding information request.

BCEV.name: Benefit Crystallisation Event
BCEV.definition: Status report advises one or more Benefit Crystallisation Events (BCE) have occurred.

SETT.name: CS Dor ICSD Settlement Information
SETT.definition: Status report is sent to provide information required for a CSD or ICSD settlement leg.

DRAW.name: Drawdown
DRAW.definition: Status report advises one or more drawdowns.

PAYA.name: Payment Advice
PAYA.definition: Status report advises cash is or has been instructed.

S012.name: Portfolio Transfer Instruction
S012.definition: Status report is sent in response to a portfolio transfer instruction.

INFO.name: Information
INFO.definition: Status report is sent to provide information pertinent to the transfer. May be sent in response to a request for transfer status.

STAT.name: Status
STAT.definition: Status report is sent to provide the status of a transfer. May be sent in response to a request for transfer status.

S005.name: Transfer In Instruction
S005.definition: Status report is sent in response to a transfer-in instruction.

S001.name: Transfer Out Instruction
S001.definition: Status report is sent in response to a transfer-out instruction.

CONV.name: Conversion Status
CONV.definition: Status report is sent to provide the number of units following a conversion.
